name: duopore-public-purchase-order-totals
description: Add up purchase orders with the discounts and shipping charges you enter.

interface.longDescription: Add up purchase orders with the discounts and shipping charges you enter. Share line items, order references, discounts and freight. See each order's total with a clear breakdown. Use it to check your figures before placing or reviewing an order. Tax and currency changes are not included. The app does not issue or approve purchase orders.
defaultPrompt: Calculate the total for these purchase orders.
Check line discounts and freight in my purchase order totals.

positive.prompt: Use Purchase Order Totals with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"orders":[{"poId":"001","freight":10}],"lines":[{"lineId":"01","poId":"001","sku":"A","quantity":4,"unitCost":25,"discountPercent":10},{"lineId":"02","poId":"001","sku":"B","quantity":2,"unitCost":5,"discountPercent":0}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 purchase orders total 110.00 before tax.","rows":[{"poId":"001","lineCount":2,"units":6,"lineSubtotal":100,"freight":10,"totalBeforeTax":110}],"warnings":["Assumes one common currency; excludes tax and exchange conversion.","Line-first two-decimal rounding; no purchase order approval or sending."]}
